newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble falls after transfers to T-bill sales.
newsitem.headline: Rouble falls after transfers to T-bill sales.

text.p: The rouble fell on Wednesday as banks covered their short positions after heavy sales of dollars two days earlier when they prepared for government securities auctions, dealers said.
rouble/dollar Jan 29 midday Jan 29 early Jan 28 close
"The dollar rose strongly today," a dealer said. "There is a big supply of roubles as people tried to buy back the dollars they sold on Monday and Tuesday."
Dmitry Slobodnik, chief dealer at Aljba-Alliance bank, said the rouble for today settlement started easier and fell to 5,630 where it found support, then rose to 5,628.
Dealers forecast slight rouble rate fluctuations in the next few days.
"With such a volume of roubles on the market the potential for its growth is not big," Slobodnik said.
